root_cause.text: The vulnerability stems from a double decrement of the s_dirtyclusters_counter in the ext4 block allocation error path, where both ext4_mb_mark_diskspace_used() and ext4_mb_new_blocks() redundantly attempt to release the dirty cluster reservation.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description explicitly identifies a "double decrement in the error path between ext4_mb_mark_diskspace_used() and the caller ext4_mb_new_blocks()" causing the counter to reach -1, and the patch diff confirms the fix by removing the counter decrement logic from ext4_mb_mark_diskspace_used() and consolidating it into a single location in ext4_mb_new_blocks().

vuln_statements.content: ext4_mb_new_blocks(handle, inode, goal, count, flags, &ex, status, ac);
